3693-4659-5224-7646.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Krallenhorde Howler, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

728-2034-2558-3490.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2923-4247.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2923-4247.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

2595-8095--5.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-8095--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing your creatures that enter this turn to enter with a +1/+1 counter on them.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2

394-586-864-3125-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-3125-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness, adding {R}{R}
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2073-6798-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-6798-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2685-3263-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-3263-5641-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

855-1887-3099-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Corpsejack Menace and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1362-1479-6517.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

240-2511-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat from step 2.

4311-5078-5231-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

57-283-1322-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-1322-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2919-3490-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3490-6752.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1482-1661-4195-4574.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

372-1031-1567.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1031-1567.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

560-2034-4593-6823.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Aunt May triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-4593-6823.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2511-3771-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2511-3771-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2511-3771-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Resolve the Geralf trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2511-3771-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

671-678-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
671-678-5670.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
671-678-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Daxos and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

811-2236-4613-6279.notablePrerequisites: Khârn has a +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
811-2236-4613-6279.description:
Activate Khârn using Witch Engine's ability by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{B} and causing an opponent to gain control of Khârn.
Khârn triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Captivating Crew by paying {4}, causing you to gain control of Khârn.
Khârn triggers, causing the opponent who controlled it to draw two cards.
Repeat.

2440-4183-4404-4758.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Corridor Monitor
2440-4183-4404-4758.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor with haste.
When the token Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Corridor Monitor, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Corridor Monitor for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

2232-2440-3433-5115.description:
Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio, and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
When the Insects enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes and Cloudstone Curio each trigger four times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Hornet Queen from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {5} for each Insect you control.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability three times by paying {6}, putting three charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability three times by removing three charge counters from it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1462-2128-4701.description: Cast Heliod's Intervention by paying {W}{W} due to Hinata, destroying all of your opponents' permanents.

679-3139-4067.description:
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain two life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping The Great Henge.
Repeat.

624-1872-5105.description:
Play Phantasmal Image, entering as a copy of Composite Golem.
Sacrifice Phantasmal Image, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Pay {1}{W} into the Sigil trigger, returning Phantasmal Image to your hand.
Loop steps 1-3, floating an amount of your choice of {R}, {G}, and/or {B}.

628-4050-4907.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite, adding one mana of any color.
When Tatterkite dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with zero +1/+1 counters due to its ability.
Repeat.
